legal_source: SI 2003/3096, Sch 1 and Sch 2 paras 2-8; LTA 1954 s38A

branch.simple_declaration_if: evidenced warning notice served at least 14 days before earliest binding date; Sch 2 para 7
branch.statutory_declaration_if: evidenced warning notice served before earliest binding date but fewer than 14 days beforehand; Sch 2 para 8
branch.unknown_dates: do not select route as complete; mark pending and obtain evidence
branch.otherwise: STOP: cannot assert contracting out has been validly completed

rules: No client identifiers in plugin templates
